stem: A dashboard shows 60% RH in two rooms, but one room is warmer. Which action best preserves useful environmental evidence?
choices: Record each room temperature and RH pair and interpret VPD with the supplied method
Assume the rooms have identical VPD
Lower RH until the percentages differ
Ignore temperature because RH is enough
rationale: Record each room temperature and RH pair and interpret VPD with the supplied method. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
